summary: Three overdue hikers (a 21-year-old man, a woman, and an 18-year-old man) got lost in the Flat Tops Wilderness near Trapper's Lake / Devil's Causeway after their parents reported them overdue; they spent a chilly night out underdressed for bad weather and were found by a helicopter on July 4, with ground crews reaching them before dark.
location: Flat Tops Wilderness, Trapper's Lake / Devil's Causeway area
responding_agency: Garfield County Search and Rescue (Routt County SAR assisting on the Yampa side)
notes: Date recorded at the missing/search date per convention: lost Sunday 2016-07-03, found by helicopter and reached by crews before dark on Monday 2016-07-04 (the Fourth of July rescue). No injuries reported.
